header.policy_gate: Home services: remarketing, Customer Match, demographics, predefined Google segments and custom segments are all allowed.

scorecard.key_number: 1 of 14 enabled ad groups on targeting
scorecard.why: Ad group 410000000011 in Plumbing only shows ads to All visitors (540 days). One list bid adjustment is ignored by Smart Bidding.

scorecard.key_number: 3 of 5 lists can serve on Search (1 retired similar list not counted)
scorecard.why: The open site and GA4 lists are well over 100 users. One 30-day list is too small for Search and one GA4 purchase list will never fill, but neither is attached.
The list serves and converts well, but fewer than 30% of the uploaded customers matched.

scorecard.key_number: 1 exclusion candidate, 1 exclusion not backed, 1 excluded unknown, 1 ignored bid adjustment
scorecard.why: Age 18-24 in AC Installation spent $573 with no conversion (1.4% of spend, under the 5% fail line). Older homeowners convert well, yet one campaign excludes them and another lowers their bids.

actions.action: Remove the -30% age 65+ bid adjustment on AC Repair
actions.detail: Smart Bidding ignores it, and it lowers bids on one of the campaign's strong segments, the opposite of what the data says.
actions.spend_basis: 90-day spend of the 2 ad groups that carry it
actions.evidence: section 4 settings query (bid_modifier 0.7) on a target_cpa campaign; segment test: strong

actions.action: Remove the +25% bid adjustment on Past customers (CRM upload) in Furnace Repair
actions.detail: Smart Bidding ignores it, so it's a dead setting. The list is strong there (21.4 conversions where 8.2 were expected), and the bid strategy already uses that signal. Removing it is housekeeping and changes nothing in the auction.
actions.spend_basis: 90-day spend of the ad group that carries it
actions.evidence: section 1 audience query (bid_modifier 1.25) on a maximize_conversions campaign

actions.detail: 23.6 conversions where 36.9 were expected (chance 1.6%). Smart Bidding already bids on this signal, so a bid adjustment would be ignored. Nothing to change now; re-check next quarter.
actions.evidence: income view, segment test against the campaign's $59 CPA (target_cpa)

actions.action: Switch ad group 410000000011 in Plumbing from targeting to observation
actions.detail: Its audience setting is on targeting, so its ads only reach people on All visitors (540 days); new customers searching for that service never see them. Set the audience setting to observation in the ad group's settings. No action this skill runs changes it.
actions.evidence: section 1 targeting settings query (AUDIENCE bid_only = false)

actions.action: Set a +30% bid adjustment on age 45-54 in AC Installation
actions.detail: 11.5 conversions where 6.1 were expected (chance 2.2%), a CPA of $89 against the campaign's $168. Maximize clicks applies bid adjustments, so this one works; it is capped at the skill's 30% limit. The action this skill runs can't set demographic bid adjustments.
actions.evidence: age view, segment test against the campaign's $168 CPA (maximize_clicks)

actions.action: Re-upload Past customers (CRM upload) with phone numbers and postal codes
actions.detail: The match rate is 24%, under 30%. The list is the account's strongest audience (21.4 conversions where 8.2 were expected in Furnace Repair), so more matched customers is the cheapest gain here. The skill never uploads customer data.
actions.spend_basis: the list's 90-day spend across the campaigns that observe it
actions.evidence: section 2 user_list query (match_rate_percentage) and the section 1 segment test

actions.action: Remove the exclusion on unknown age in Furnace Repair
actions.detail: It sits on 1 ad group and removes everyone Google can't classify. Elsewhere unknown age is 14% of spend at a $58 CPA. No action this skill runs removes a criterion.
actions.spend_basis: 90-day spend of the ad group that carries it
actions.evidence: section 4 settings query (negative = true on an undetermined segment) and the age view elsewhere

actions.action: Review the age 65+ exclusion in Plumbing
actions.detail: It sits on 1 of the campaign's 3 ad groups. Elsewhere in the account 65+ brought 82.4 conversions at $39, under the $65 target. Ask who added it and why before removing it.
actions.spend_basis: 90-day spend of the ad group that carries it
actions.evidence: section 4 settings query and the age view outside that ad group, against the target CPA

actions.detail: 0.0 conversions where 3.4 were expected, after $573 (chance of zero by luck 3.3%). Run once per ad group, 2 ad groups.
actions.evidence: age view, segment test against the campaign's $168 CPA

actions.action: Add Booked a service (540 days) in observation to 2 Plumbing ad groups
actions.detail: 1,150 users on Search, not attached anywhere; past customers come back for other jobs. Ad groups 410000000010 and 410000000012 already observe, so the list reports without narrowing reach. Ad group 410000000011 is left out until it is switched to observation. No bid adjustment: Target CPA ignores it.
actions.evidence: section 2 user_list query and section 1 targeting settings

policy_gate.category_matched: none: heating, cooling and plumbing repair for homes is not a sensitive interest category, and the ads don't offer housing, jobs or credit
policy_gate.how_matched: the business the user gave, checked against the campaign names
policy_gate.note: If the account starts advertising financing for new systems, those ads may fall under the US and Canada consumer finance rule, which rules out age, gender and parental status targeting on them.

audience_segments.finding: Ad group 410000000011 in Plumbing has its audience setting on targeting, so its ads only reach people on All visitors (540 days); every other enabled ad group observes. Brand has no segment, which is fine for a brand campaign. The +25% adjustment on Past customers (CRM upload) in Furnace Repair is ignored by Smart Bidding.

inventory.name: Purchasers - GA4
inventory.state: open but empty: its source is not sending members

notes: 3 open lists clear the 100-user minimum on Search and Display. The one attached list, All visitors (540 days), can serve; its problem is the targeting setting in section 1, not its size.

Furnace pages (30 days) has 70 users on Search, under the 100 minimum, and 180 on Display. It is not attached anywhere; a 30-day window is short for a Search list, so widen it to 90 days before using it.
Purchasers - GA4 is open but empty: the site sends calls and booking forms, not a purchase event, so the list will stay at 0. Build a GA4 list on the booking event instead, or leave it.
1 similar list is retired by Google and left out of the counts.
Booked a service (540 days) (1,150 users on Search) is not attached anywhere. Past customers come back for other services, so it is worth observing on Plumbing.

customer_match.finding: The list can serve (1,900 users on Search) and is the account's best audience: 21.4 conversions where 8.2 were expected in Furnace Repair. But only 24% of the uploaded customers matched, under the 30% bar: the upload probably lacks phone numbers, or names with postal codes.

demographics.caution: 105 segments were tested across sections 1 and 4, so about 5 could cross 5% by chance. Costly and strong segments are worth watching, not proof.

fixes_offered_note: Shown for the user's yes; nothing was run. After a yes, the skill re-runs the section 4 settings query or the section 1 inventory query to show each criterion is there.
unknowns: The API returns no upload date for Past customers (CRM upload), and its members never expire (life span 10000). Ask when it was last uploaded.
PMax | All services returns no rows in the demographic or audience views, so its audience signals are not reviewed here.
Excluded segments have no data in their own ad groups, so their cost is read from the rest of the account.
